entities.name: Szymon Marcin Kossakowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Szymon Marcin Kossakowski was a Polish–Lithuanian nobleman (szlachcic), and one of the leaders of the Targowica Confederation. In 1793, he became the last Grand Hetman of Lithuania.
